GH-802: persist structured numeric measurements with test runs
Linked verification records whether a run passed but cannot persist what it measured, forcing coverage, latency, bundle-size, error-budget, and duplication values into unqueryable prose.
Issue
open
harness:codex

Test-run records accept typed numeric measurements with a name, value, optional unit, optional threshold, and timestamp without requiring an extension; Measurements remain bound to the producing run and accumulate as a bounded deterministic series rather than overwriting prior evidence; CLI, SDK, MCP, schemas, contracts, storage normalization, migrations, and public types expose the same measurement model; Read surfaces can filter and aggregate measurements, including a metric-below query and a latest-versus-previous diff; Focused, integration, acceptance, compatibility, and exact 100 percent coverage gates prove persistence and query behavior
project management = context management
Make quantitative verification evidence a first-class queryable SDK primitive
Agents and fleet operators can compare quality evidence without parsing prose
Adds a universal numeric evidence series usable by any project domain while retaining bounded item storage
Quality, performance, reliability, and size measurements are durable, attributable, and queryable across items
